text: Four. When did we ask for the bill? I don't know. At least half an hour ago. I know they're busy, but this is ridiculous. I think we should just go. What? Without paying? Are you mad? Well, they don't seem to want our money, do they? Don't be ridiculous. I mean, what would happen if they called the police? They wouldn't do that. Anyway, the restaurant doesn't deserve the money. I mean, the food wasn't that great. The asparagus was okay. Yeah, but the portions weren't very generous, and the rest of the food was pretty bland. Those vegetables were really overcooked. Yes, but you can't just leave without paying, can you? No, I suppose not.
